page_title: SheetAI — AI inside Google Sheets for text, images, video & music

sources.entry: SheetAI.app - AI-powered tool to quickly generate formulas for Google Sheets. #freemium

summary.name: SheetAI
summary.one_liner: SheetAI is a Google Sheets add-on that runs bulk text AI and Replicate-powered image, video, and music generation inside spreadsheet formulas.
use_cases: Generate bulk ad copy and taglines from a column of prompts
Create product images at scale from spreadsheet rows
Classify or tag messy datasets without code
Batch-generate short videos or music tracks per SKU
Draft follow-up emails and job descriptions from a sheet
summary.what_it_does: SheetAI adds AI formulas to Google Sheets so a user can write a prompt in a cell and drag it down to fill many rows with text output. It supports bulk text tasks such as writing, classifying, and summarizing, using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Grok models. Through Replicate, it can generate images, video, and music from prompts in a column, with a =SHEETAI_IMAGE(A2) style formula shown on the page. Users can bring their own API keys (BYOK) and pay only the provider, or use hosted plans that do not require a key. The page also lists a formula generator in the sidebar.
notable: Bulk fill-down formulas that run AI across hundreds of rows
Bring-your-own-key support for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Replicate
Replicate integration for image, video, and music generation inside Sheets
Listed in a collective AI tools list under Data & BI as an AI formula generator
caveats: Hosted plans cost $12/month (Starter) or $29/month (Pro); Pro Yearly is $290/year
Hosted usage is capped at about 500 AI runs/month on Starter; Pro is described as soft unlimited
Bulk image, video, and music generation requires Replicate; users pay their own provider or Replicate bill under BYOK
